jobs.job_title: Modern Software Engineer - AI & LLM-Aware Development
jobs.job_description:
Modern Software Engineer AI LLM-Aware Development

A hands-on programmer who understands modern software development and can use LLMs and AI coding tools without outsourcing engineering judgment to the tools.
Software Engineering Hands-on role AdTech + AI
What we need


Someone who can still write, read and debug code.

We are looking for a modern software engineer with recent practical programming experience. The specific language matters less than the ability to understand a codebase, reason about a problem, use modern tools, and deliver working software.


Core expectations

Recent hands-on programming experience in at least one current programming language.
Ability to understand requirements and turn them into working software.
Comfort reading, modifying, debugging and testing existing code.
Working knowledge of APIs, databases, version control and deployment concepts.


AI-assisted development

Practical experience with one or more LLM or AI coding tools.
Ability to use AI tools for exploration, coding, debugging, documentation or testing.
Ability to review generated code critically rather than accepting it blindly.
Curiosity about agentic and LLM-enabled development workflows.


Evidence we value

GitHub repositories, technical projects or other demonstrable work.
Open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory.
If employer restrictions prevent showing code, describe the architecture and contribution and demonstrate what can safely be shown.
We care more about evidence of real work than a long list of tools.


Useful background

Web applications, APIs, AdTech, data systems, automation, cloud environments or other production software experience can all be relevant.


What you dont need

You do not need to know every AI framework or every tool in the ecosystem. Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.


Interested

Send a resume and links to relevant technical work or a short description of projects you can discuss.

ML Engineer, LLM Training
Bengaluru Full-time Junior (1-3 yrs)


About EkaCare and the mission
EkaCare is Indias connected healthcare platform: an EMR that doctors run their practices on, a personal health record used by millions of Indians, and one of the deepest integrations with Indias ABDM digital-health rails. Our Parrotlet family of medical models already serves Indian doctors in production, and we open-source our work where it counts.


The role
Youll rotate across data, evals and training tooling with direct mentorship from the people running the big runs and grow into a pretraining or post-training specialisation within your first year.


What youll do
Run and extend the evaluation harness: benchmark sweeps, dashboards, regression tracking across checkpoints.
Build data-quality tooling: filters, dedup checks, samplers, "look at the data" utilities everyone thanks you for.
Monitor training runs and make their logs and metrics legible.
Build internal tools that make researchers measurably faster.
Learn relentlessly, paper clubs, ablation reviews, and real responsibility early.
What we look for
1-3 years (or even fresh graduate) with excellent coding; Python youre proud of, and the instincts to debug anything.
ML fundamentals you can defend on a whiteboard, not just import.
Evidence you build things nobody asked you to: repos, competition results, a tool your classmates used.
Hunger. This team moves fast, and the learning curve is the point.
Bonus
Open-source PRs; Kaggle or competitive programming.
Coursework or projects in NLP/LLMs; interest in Indic languages.
Why this is a rare gig
Open source, with on it : weights and technical reports ship publicly.
India-scale mission : models for a billion people in their own languages.
Compute that s rare to fine : dedicated multi-node H200 training under a national grant.
Small senior team: you work with the people who own the recipe.
A live deployment path : Government institutes, EkaCares doctors and patients use what you ship.


Full-Time Employee Benefits
Medical Insurance Accidental Insurance
Maternity Paternity Benefits
PF, Gratuity, Leave Encashment
Salary Advance Policy

ABOUT THE ROLE
As our AI/ML Prompt Engineer, you will own the intelligence behind EMMA the LLM and RAG systems that power our chatbot, voice agent and telephony services. You will design, build and optimise the AI models and prompt architectures that allow EMMA to understand patient needs, retrieve accurate clinical information, and respond naturally across text and voice channels. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where your work will directly shape patient outcomes across hundreds of GP surgeries.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Architect and deploy LLM- and RAG-based systems that ingest data sources, generate accurate responses, and power both chatbot and voice agent interactions.
Design, iterate and optimise prompts and voice-agent dialogue flows to maximise response relevance, reduce latency and ensure clinical safety across text and voice channels.
Partner with frontend (Next.js, React) and backend (NestJS, Python) teams to integrate AI and voice agent components into our Azure-hosted microservices architecture.
Instrument AI and voice-agent pipelines, analyse logs and user feedback, troubleshoot edge cases, and implement continuous-learning improvements.
Stay abreast of the latest advances in LLMs, RAG, conversational AI frameworks, and (GDPR, DTAC) to inform our technical roadmap.
Define and execute rigorous test plans in collaboration with QA to validate model accuracy, voice-agent performance and compliance with healthcare standards.
Mentor junior engineers and advocate for best practices in MLOps, prompt engineering, voice-agent design and model governance.
ESSENTIAL
Demonstrable hands-on experience with prompt engineering, LLMs (e.g. GPT, LLaMA, Mistral), RAG frameworks, and voice-agent or dialogue-system design, with shipped projects or open-source contributions.
Advanced proficiency in Python for ML/AI development.
Experience building APIs in NestJS and familiarity with Next.js/React for frontend integration.
Strong understanding of Azure services (App Services, Functions, Cognitive Services), containerisation (Docker), and relational databases (MySQL).
Experience designing microservices, distributed architectures and RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI and voice-agent concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working remotely and collaborating asynchronously with a UK-based team during UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
DESIRABLE
Contributions to open-source LLM or RAG tooling.
Experience with MLOps pipelines, model monitoring and automated evaluation frameworks.
Background in speech-to-text, text-to-speech, or telephony integration.
LOGISTICS
Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.
Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
Start date: Flexible.
WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive package depending on experience
Potential share options
Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support
Remote working with a collaborative, supportive team
HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT
At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is genuinely improving primary care. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:
Impact over optics. We measure success by patient outcomes, not busy work
Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context
Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our product
Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment

At NStarX, we live by our mission: being the Lodestar to Success for enterprises navigating the rapidly evolving digital landscape. We build cutting-edge, production-ready platforms that integrate advanced AI, cloud-native architecture, and robust data engineering to solve complex business challenges at scale. If you thrive in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, architectural ownership, and production-first innovation, NStarX is where your impact will shine.


JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced and driven Agentic AI Platform Engineer to design and build the core backend infrastructure for our enterprise-grade Agentic AI platform. In this role, you will move beyond prototyping to architect robust services handling agent orchestration, model routing, enterprise security, cost telemetry, and deep data integration. You will be instrumental in ensuring our AI systems are scalable, observable, secure, and seamlessly connected to enterprise data ecosystems.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Infrastructure Development: Build and maintain critical backend services for model routing, dynamic agent orchestration, and multi-agent graph protocols.
Integration Data Pipelines: Implement and optimize production-grade RAG pipelines (retrieval, embedding/vector search, and grounding) and develop robust enterprise connectors (SQL, Kafka, Salesforce, SharePoint).
Security Compliance: Engineer built-in data protection mechanisms, including PII detection/redaction, RBAC/ABAC policy enforcement, and tamper-evident audit logs.
FinOps Observability: Instrument complete system telemetry (tracing, metrics, and logs) and design usage/cost tracking mechanisms for multi-provider AI workloads.
Deployment Scaling: Design resilient REST APIs and deploy production services onto cloud-managed container orchestrators (Kubernetes/ECS).


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Expert Python Async Frameworks: Extensive hands-on experience building production services using Fast API or equivalent asynchronous Python frameworks.
Production AI Systems: Track record of shipping at least one LLM-powered system to production (multi-step orchestration, advanced RAG, or autonomous agents) prototypes or toy apps do not qualify.
Agent/Graph Frameworks: Practical experience with agent frameworks Lang Graph is highly preferred (Lang Chain, AutoGen, or comparable frameworks considered).
Data Caching: Strong competency running PostgreSQL and Redis in high-throughput production environments.
Cloud DevOps: Direct experience deploying and managing production services on Kubernetes (EKS) or AWS ECS.
Observability: Solid fundamentals in system instrumentation, specifically using Open Telemetry tracing, structured logging, and metrics collection.
API Design: Proven ability to design secure, clean, and scalable REST APIs integrated with legacy enterprise ecosystems.


GOOD TO HAVE

LLM Gateway Management: Experience using LiteLLM, Kong, Portkey, or Azure APIM for virtual keys, budget tracking, fallback chains, and caching.
Advanced Protocols: Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP) for building or consuming MCP servers/clients, as well as multi-agent protocols.
Cloud AI Platforms: Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or cross-provider model routing.
Compliance Engineering: Knowledge of WORM retention, hash-chained audit logs, and automatic PII masking.
AI FinOps: Experience setting up cost instrumentation and cost-tracking dashboards for massive LLM workloads.
Enterprise Middleware: Experience building enterprise data connectors or working with event streaming via Apache Kafka.
Policy-as-Code: Familiarity with OPA-based policy enforcement and sophisticated RBAC/ABAC security design.
